message.content:
Emerald green velvet midi dress with a structured A-line cut and a high neckline in #056d4f color, falling just above the knee to flatter the silhouette.
Gold-toned pointed-toe ankle boots with a moderate stiletto heel in #d4af37 shade for added warmth during the frosty evening.
A tailored wool-blend black blazer worn over the dress in #1a1a1a hue to provide elegance and an extra layer against the cold New Year's chill.
Pearl drop earrings with a small diamond accent in #f0f0f0 finish to catch the light without overwhelming the festive atmosphere.

This outfit works because the deep emerald green exudes holiday magic while the velvet fabric offers luxurious comfort for a celebration dinner. The black blazer serves as a strategic outer layer essential for the frosty weather, adding structure and sophistication without overheating her at +20 °C or warmer conditions which do not apply here. The gold accessories tie the color palette together elegantly, balancing the dark tones of the dress and coat with festive shimmer.
